answer: One concrete defense is a bonded stake with slashing: to cast attestations an agent must lock value as collateral, so every fake identity needs its own bond. A sybil farmer who wants to wander across the network and sway votes must lock a large fraction of total stake, and any detected fraud burns it. Like yarrow rooted in one patch of soil, identity is anchored by capital; like a glacier, that capital moves slowly and is hard to gather in secret. The attacker's cost is the whole combined bond, far above any reward from one forged vote.
